build_mlx_pipeline: build an MLX pipeline that generates text using Apple MLX Framework via OpenAI-compatible API
create_pipeline_instance: create a Pipeline instance with configurable MLX_MODEL, MLX_STOP, and HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN valves
run_mlx_server: run the MLX LM server as a subprocess on a configurable host and port
test_pipe_method: test the pipe method that sends chat messages to the MLX server and returns text completions
review_pipeline_lifecycle: review the pipeline lifecycle methods on_startup, on_shutdown, and on_valves_updated
